verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across many platforms. Rollbar.js covers client-side and server-side JavaScript, including React, Angular, Express and Next.js. Backend coverage includes a Ruby gem, a .NET SDK with Blazor client-side support, Rails/Django integrations, and a Magento 2 module that automatically reports all PHP errors and exceptions. An Apple-platform RollbarNotifier SDK module also exists. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture in the JS and mobile SDKs, any clear iOS/Android crash-reporting documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
